findings.source_quote: The hymn, "When All Thy Mercies O My God," written in 1712, has been published in 994 hymnals and is to this day in the list of the best 100 hymns ever written.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the hymn title into Swedish to match the article's target-language rendering of other titles, or mark it clearly as an original-title in English. e.g. replace "When All Thy Mercies O My God," with "'När alla dina nåder, o min Gud,' (eng. 'When All Thy Mercies O My God')" while preserving the existing HTML tags and order.
findings.translation_quote: Sången, "When All Thy Mercies O My God," skriven 1712, har utgivits i 994 sångböcker och finns än i dag med på listan över de 100 bästa sånger som någonsin skrivits.

findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic Swedish rendering for 'My rising soul surveys' that preserves the sense of the soul lifted or rising to behold God's mercies. Suggested phrasing: "Min upplyfta själ betraktar" or "Min uppstigande själ ser". Keep the same HTML structure for the stanza.
